title: Scotland's most capped players
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Scotland in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Ryan Christie: Ryan Christie is 11th with 71, just outside.
notes.Andy Robertson: Andy Robertson had 97 caps at the end of the 2026 World Cup; he passed 100 in October 2026, which doesn't count here.

checks: Wikipedia's records page on 1 July 2026 and RSSSF (to 24 June 2026, Scotland's last match before the cut-off) give the same ten and figures; Transfermarkt's match data counted to 19 July 2026 agrees (Robertson 97, McGinn 89, Christie 71) except Fletcher, 81 there and 80 in both other sources (80 used; 6th either way).
